The College of Visual Arts and Design (CVAD) at the University of North Texas is searching for a Visiting Assistant Professor in Communication Design with a focus on UX and interaction design. The position is a full-time, nine-month, visiting role (up to a 3-year term) and is based in Denton, TX. The successful candidate will teach undergraduate and graduate students in the UX/Interaction Design concentration, develop community and industry partnerships, and contribute to CVAD's new Curiosity Lab. The Curiosity Lab is an interdisciplinary innovation engine within CVAD that integrates human-centered design, experiential learning, and advanced technologies to prepare students and faculty for emerging creative economies.
